_note: What the packaging and release scripts need to know about this module (packaging/module-info.ps1 reads it). The version is not here: it is the suite's, in shared/version.js. 'product' must match js/product.js. The tour's demo pack is loaded on demand by the folder app, so the single-file build carries it inline (inlineExtras) to keep ?tour working with no sibling files. It reads spt-review-pack and writes spt-review; it needs nothing else from any other module.

tests._alone: Pages tools/run-tests.ps1 -Parallel runs on their own: scroll and layout checks (the scroll position after each action in speed, the 420 px and A4 widths in app and pages, the 768 px view in ux, the outline scroll in fixes).
